title: Gurdwara Dam Dama Sahib
tagline: Gurdwara Dam Dama Sahib — Sacred Sikh Shrine & Nizamuddin UNESCO Heritage

heroImage.alt: Gurdwara Dam Dama Sahib iconic heritage in Delhi, India

overview.short: Gurdwara Dam Dama Sahib in Nizamuddin East commemorates the historic meeting between Tenth Sikh Guru Gobind Singh Ji and Prince Mu’azzam in 1707.
overview.description: Situated near Humayun’s Tomb and Sarai Kale Khan in South Delhi, Gurdwara Dam Dama Sahib is a revered historic Sikh shrine built on the site where Guru Gobind Singh Ji met the Mughal Prince Mu’azzam (later Emperor Bahadur Shah I) in 1707. The serene white marble Gurdwara stands adjacent to world-renowned Mughal heritage including Humayun’s Tomb, Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya Dargah, Sunder Nursery, and the Millennium Indraprastha Park.
overview.about: The shrine hosts grand annual celebrations during Hola Mohalla with traditional Sikh martial arts (Gatka) displays and 24-hour Guru ka Langar. Its location makes it the gateway to Delhi’s richest historic enclave spanning seven centuries of Sultanate, Mughal, and Sikh history.

howToReach.roadNote: Located right next to Sarai Kale Khan ISBT and Hazrat Nizamuddin Railway Station. Served directly by Sarai Kale Khan - Nizamuddin Metro Station (Pink Line).

routes.byTrain: Airport Express to New Delhi + Pink Line

topPlaces.description: Exquisite octagonal Suri-era mausoleum adorned with glazed ceramic tiles and an attached heritage red stone mosque.

topPlaces.name: Nila Gumbad (Blue Dome)
topPlaces.description: Distinctive early Mughal tomb crowned with shimmering Persian blue turquoise tiles located next to the railway line.

topPlaces.name: Sunder Nursery Heritage Park
topPlaces.description: 90-acre UNESCO-recognized heritage park with 15 restored Mughal monuments, lush botanical gardens, and weekend farmers markets.

image.alt: Sunder Nursery Heritage Park in Gurdwara Dam Dama Sahib, Delhi

topPlaces.name: Chausath Khamba & Mirza Ghalib’s Tomb

itinerary.title: Day 1 — Sacred Meeting Place & Mughal Splendour

items.note: Participate in morning prayers, kirtan, and community langar at the sacred shrine.
Explore the UNESCO garden-tomb architecture and tile-roofed octagonal pavilions.
Relax among landscaped lakes, botanical flowerbeds, and restored Mughal pavilions.
Immerse in transcendent Sufi music and sample kebabs in the heritage Nizamuddin lanes.

faq.q: What is the historical significance of Gurdwara Dam Dama Sahib?
faq.a: It marks the historic 1707 meeting where Tenth Guru Gobind Singh Ji agreed to support Prince Mu’azzam in the succession battle following Emperor Aurangzeb’s death.
